card.name: Just before 'was observed/found/reported'
card.fires_on: The last word of a noun phrase or auxiliary right before a verb like observed, found, noted or reported. It appears in findings statements in drug labels and studies.

modes.label: Subject before 'been found/reported'
modes.description: A subject or auxiliary such as has or have, just before a passive verb of finding.
modes.example: not a single live bird infected with H5N1<< has>> been found

modes.label: Effect noun before 'is observed/noted'
modes.description: A noun naming an effect or change, followed by a passive verb of observation.
modes.example: if a reduction in<< efficacy>> is observed

modes.label: Word end in a condition term
modes.description: The ending of a medical term where a noting or reporting verb is expected next.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the words found, observed and detected coming next, which suggests that slot is filled by another word.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a sentence is about to say that something was seen, found or reported.
